summary: Stage 2's pooler m=1 kernel took 30.8 us in the judge profile, past this hypothesis's own supersede threshold (> 28 us) and 1.62x short of the 19.0 us kill gate. Stage 2's log also shows the kernel is decode/issue-bound inside the SM, not memory-latency-bound, which is what warp-specialized cp.async producers and a persistent split target. Mark superseded; do not spend a check on it as written.
justification: Stage 2 (job f1024212dd2f49f3, 0.887x [0.874, 0.900], 9/9 pass, bit-exact): pooler m=1 30.8 us (incumbent 19.0), m=8/16/32 31.0/34.7/39.6; unpooler m=16/32 32.7/34.3 (incumbent ~18.5/18.1); qkv_gate m=1/8/16/32 18.9/19.2/22.2/25.7 (incumbent 12.2-14.2). Every routed row 1.5-2.1x slower. Stage 1->2 bought 1.32x for 2x warps; stage 3 needs another 1.62x to tie. Warm vs cold L2 barely differ (pooler 33.1 vs 40.3, unpooler 31.3 vs 38.6), and qkv_gate's L2-resident compressed stream runs at ~1.5 TB/s compressed vs the incumbent's ~3 TB/s raw from L2: decode ALU/issue and the mma.sync chain are the limit. Only part 2 (double-buffered decoded A fragments) targets it, and it competes for registers. NT growth +29-36% suggests dequant-once did not take effect or per-token work dominates. Compression ratio 0.761 caps the byte saving at ~24%; qkv_gate is L2-resident, so compression can only lose there.
confounders: bf16-m32-swapab-wgmma-triton / bf16-shape-gated-triton-winners-combo: the incumbents; stage 2 misses by 1.5-2.1x, loss belongs to the lossless kernel.
Base drift: BEST is the unlanded 1.2215 restack, whose incumbents are faster still on these rows.
interference: No companion. The deciding question is physics: can the exp4 decoder plus mma.sync reach >= 3.3 TB/s compressed? If revived, the next stage should first measure decode-only throughput from L2-resident data (no mma, no output) in prepare; if decode alone cannot beat ~2.7 TB/s compressed, the line is dead.
rules_flags: If revived: no child processes, plain cp.async.cg, sm_90a-only, sync+print per self-check launch, check only; named-barrier thread counts must match exactly.
open_questions: Why does stage-2 kernel time grow 29-36% from NT=8 to NT=32 if dequant happens once per fragment?
Drop qkv_gate from scope in any revival?
Is this rewrite slot better spent elsewhere given ~+6-8% on 4 of 6 loads vs the 1.2215 restack?
